The [[Trade Federation/Legends|Trade Federation]] used '''laser turrets''' at the [[Invasion of Naboo/Legends|Invasion]] of [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]]<ref name="BFN" /> in [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]].<ref name="The New Essential Chronology">''Battle for Naboo'' itself refers to its events taking place during the [[Invasion of Naboo/Legends|Invasion of Naboo]]. ''[[The New Essential Chronology]]'' establishes that the invasion happens in [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]].</ref> Several of the [[Laser cannon/Legends|laser turrets]] were at the [[N-1 assembly site]] to [[Mission to the Naboo mountains|inderdict]] the [[Naboo Resistance]]. Numerous turrets were also placed at a [[Trade Federation base]]; the defenses were [[Attack on disabled base|destroyed]] by a resistance strike force. Turrets also defended Federation [[Slavery/Legends|slave]] camps on the [[Andrevea River]]. The turrets were also placed around [[Borvo]] the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt's]] base on [[Porso Hill]]. Additional turrets were placed along the [[south ridge of Theed]] and were [[Battle of the south ridge|destroyed]] during the battle there. The turrets were placed on pedestals and had a triangular casing with the barrel extending outward. They were capable of attacking air and ground targets.<ref name="BFN" />

==Behind the scenes==
The laser turrets appear in the [[2000]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: Episode I: Battle for Naboo]]''.
